thread:
maya-billing: heads-up - Beacon Diagnostics (BCN-901) invoice INV-9901 for $21,250 failed. Card attempt declined and ACH microdeposits look pending (no confirmation). Customer asked if we can do FedNow / RTP instead of a SWIFT wire to speed it up.
finance-bot: retry attempt #2 for INV-9901 at 2026-07-10T13:40Z - result: FAILED (card_declined). ACH microdeposit status: pending.
jon-csm: AP says their bank supports FedNow and they'd prefer same-day instant settlement. CFO said they'll lose payroll window otherwise. They can provide a signed scan of the payment authorization.
sam-finops: policy check: we support RTP for domestic USD payouts under $25k, but ops must confirm rails and 2FA. Need finance approval for >$10k. @tom-fp&a can you ack? Also verify KYC.
tom-fp&a: KYC all green. I approve RTP for this invoice up to $25k. Please attach signed form + bank routing details.
maya-billing: requested signed PDF and FedNow routing (routing + account + payee phone/email if required). Holding any more retries until 14:00 PT. @jon-csm can you nudge AP?
jon-csm: pinged AP: "We can accept a scanned PDF + short confirmation email. If you prefer, I can collect the signature and upload on your behalf." They said they will send the scan in 10 minutes.
finance-bot: attachment received "Beacon_INV9901_auth.pdf" uploaded by jon-csm at 2026-07-10T13:52Z.
sam-finops: received. running routing verification and open-banking check for FedNow. Also confirm destination bank supports RTP for corporate accounts.
ida-ops: ops note: FedNow/RTP payouts require beneficiary confirmation and must be scheduled as 'instant' payout; we perform 2FA for >$1k. We'll need the "Payment Purpose" text set to INV-9901 / BCN-901. Ops can execute RTP once verification is green.
maya-billing: created ticket FIN-2026-3833 and attached docs. tagging ops + tom.
sam-finops: verification complete - bank supports FedNow and account matches KYC. Creating payment instruction and routing to ops for 2FA.
ida-ops: performing 2FA now. executing RTP; target outbound instant settlement by 15:30 PT. Will attach payment confirmation (payment ID) to ticket when done.
finance-bot: payment executed: RTP id RTP-20260710-55821 at 2026-07-10T15:28Z - status: SENT.
maya-billing: received confirmation and updated ticket FIN-2026-3833 with payment id. Please keep audit copy.
tom-fp&a: noted for month-end reconciliation. attach settlement screenshot to ticket.
jon-csm: customer confirmed funds received within minutes and said operations restored. :tada:
maya-billing: closing thread after receipts uploaded. :white_check_mark:
